title: CM Studio+ launches SwapBoard to help personal care companies put surplus ingredients to work
summary: New platform connects companies with excess cosmetic ingredients while helping formulators overcome minimum-order quantities

extraction.key_fact: CM Studio+가 잉여 화장품 원료를 보유한 기업과 최소 주문 수량 극복이 필요한 처방 연구자를 연결하는 플랫폼 SwapBoard를 출시했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: CM Studio+ launches SwapBoard to help personal care companies put surplus ingredients to work
